limits: Actual Git test deliberately uses synthetic reservation and source-observation fixture; not durable SQL authorization.
No native offer, worker download/hydration, grant or provider execution qualification.

Chunks enforce exact manifest and file size with nofollow descriptors, bounded seek/read, metadata checks. Worker must verify complete assembled digest; same-size bundle replacement between requests is not certified away.
Timeout does not kill a blocked OS file read. Two shared blocking slots remain held until actual return, bounding outstanding work while subsequent calls refuse.
No host power-loss, physical ENOSPC, concurrent trusted-operator mutation or filesystem snapshot guarantee.
